verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Alma serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the firm, so an agent can be pointed at it. Beyond that file there is little agent-oriented documentation: the markdown version of the visa guides returns 404, and only the opening line of the llms.txt content is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of what llms.txt covers beyond its header line, markdown/agent-readable versions of the guide pages, any independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.tryalma.com/llms.txt # Alma: An immigration law firm for companies and individuals
